title: Set up backend canister to support inquiry submissions

requirements.text: Update the Motoko backend actor (backend/main.mo) to persist submitted inquiries across canister upgrades by storing inquiries in stable state instead of only in-memory variables.

quotes: now set the backend as well

acceptanceCriteria: After a canister upgrade, previously submitted inquiries are still available via the backend retrieval API.
Backend build succeeds with the updated stable state definitions.

requirements.text: Align backend validation with the frontend forms by validating all required fields for inquiry submission (name, country, email, category, message) and returning clear English error messages when validation fails.

quotes: now set the backend as well

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting an inquiry with any missing required field traps/rejects with a clear English error message indicating the missing requirement.
Submitting a valid inquiry succeeds and stores the inquiry.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend API surface supports the existing frontend integration by keeping the submitInquiry signature compatible with frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and providing a query method to retrieve inquiries (e.g., getAllInquiries) that returns stored inquiries.

quotes: now set the backend as well

acceptanceCriteria: The frontend inquiry submission flows (Contact page and Catalogue request) successfully call actor.submitInquiry without runtime actor/method mismatch errors.
The backend exposes a query method that returns the stored inquiry records in a structured array type.
End-to-end: submitting an inquiry from the UI results in the inquiry being retrievable from the backend retrieval method.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x) or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding third-party auth providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or off-chain storage.
Building an admin UI for viewing inquiries (unless explicitly requested later).
